ctx.x: So I still wasn't -- you know, it didn't excite me too much. But Carlos Castel., of course, he kept harping on it and they kept after him. "We have to have Nellie Lutcher. We want Nellie Lutcher to come. She's got to come. She's got to come." So finally, I decided to -- that I would go, and it was so marvelous, and I took my musicians with me the first time. I think we did eight weeks, and then we went back the second time and did ten weeks. And I played

all over England, and then Scotland. I went to Glasgow, Edinburgh, and did what they called -- let's see, it was something like our vaudeville here, and they didn't call it vaudeville. They called it -- what did they call the theater shows? Oh, that'll come to me too.
